mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad economic slowdown in consumer demand and manufacturing output, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime where the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, the increased cost of capital suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS increasing for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a contraction in residential construction that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market deterioration, depressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime where industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, the contraction in output signals reduced corporate activity and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
